line: You’ll never make me stay, so take the weight off of me I know your every move, so won’t you just let me be I been here times before, but I was too blind to see That you seduce every man, but ain’t no seducing me
vault_lines: You'll never make me stay, so take the weight off of me
meaning:
Lucci borrows these first lines of his verse from the first verse of Michael Jackson’s 1988 song “Dirty Diana,” where Jackson sings:

You’ll never make me stay
So take your weight off of me
I know your every move
So won’t you just let me be?
I’ve been here times before
But I was too blind to see
That you seduce every man
This time you won’t seduce me

vault_lines: Dirty Diana, drippin' my diamonds, I'm drippin' designer (fashion)
meaning: “Dirty Diana” is a song by 80’s pop musician, Michael Jackson. In the song he speaks about a groupie, Diana, and the tenuous relationship they had.
